_meta.purpose: Conformance golden fixture for one shipped connector (AC4). Locks the connector's per-concept conformance declaration (status/reason/mapper/field_gaps) from discovery/concepts/conformance.py. The CI gate (tests/contract/test_r2_0_b4_t5_conformance_fixtures.py) fails if a shipped connector has no fixture here, and pins each fixture to the registry so a conformance change cannot ship without updating its golden.
_meta.note: Every 'supported' concept's mapper must resolve in T2's mapper registry (discovery.concepts.mappers.resolve_mapper) — the gate checks it. The raw→concept correctness of each mapper is proven by T2's connector-mapping test.
